Thank you for considering Helix Bank! Our high-yield savings account does indeed currently offer a competitive Annual Percentage Yield (APY) for new and existing customers. However, please note that interest rates can change based on market conditions and other factors. To ensure you get the most accurate and up-to-date information, it's best to check with our mobile app or contact our secure phone line at 1-800-HELIX-CS.

If you decide to move your funds, we can guide you through the process to help make the transition smooth. Let me know if you have any questions or need assistance!<|im_end|>
